subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'Swimming improves stamina.'
explanation: The gerund 'Swimming' functions as a noun and is the subject. 'Stamina' is the object of the verb 'improves'.
explanation_pa: gerund 'Swimming' ਇੱਥੇ noun ਵਜੋਂ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ subject ਹੈ। 'Stamina', verb 'improves' ਦਾ object ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'To finish the syllabus on time requires steady effort.'
options: To finish the syllabus on time
explanation: The infinitive phrase 'To finish the syllabus on time' functions as the subject. 'Steady effort' is the object of 'requires'.
explanation_pa: infinitive phrase 'To finish the syllabus on time' ਇੱਥੇ subject ਵਜੋਂ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Steady effort', 'requires' ਦਾ object ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the subject in: 'Here comes the inspection team.'
explanation: In this inverted construction, the subject follows the verb. 'Here' indicates place and does not name what comes.
explanation_pa: ਇਸ ਉਲਟੇ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਵਾਲੀ ਬਣਤਰ ਵਿੱਚ subject, verb ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Here' ਥਾਂ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਕਿ ਕੌਣ ਜਾਂ ਕੀ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'The revised list of candidates from Bathinda reached the recruitment cell.'
options: The revised list of candidates from Bathinda
explanation: The complete subject includes the head noun 'list' and all its modifiers. 'The revised list' leaves out the modifying phrase 'of candidates from Bathinda'.
explanation_pa: complete subject ਵਿੱਚ head noun 'list' ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ modifiers ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ 'The revised list' ਚੁਣਨ ਨਾਲ modifying phrase 'of candidates from Bathinda' ਰਹਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'Who did the selection panel recommend for the scholarship?'
explanation: The selection panel performs the act of recommending and is the subject. 'Who' is the fronted object asking about the person recommended.
explanation_pa: ਸਿਫ਼ਾਰਸ਼ ਕਰਨ ਦਾ ਕੰਮ selection panel ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਹ subject ਹੈ। 'Who' ਅੱਗੇ ਲਿਆਂਦਾ ਗਿਆ object ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਉਸ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਬਾਰੇ ਪੁੱਛਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਾਰਸ਼ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject of the main clause in: 'That the server failed during registration surprised everyone.'
options: That the server failed during registration
explanation: The entire that-clause functions as the subject of 'surprised'. 'The server' is the subject of the subordinate clause, not of the main clause.
explanation_pa: ਪੂਰਾ that-clause, 'surprised' ਦੇ subject ਵਜੋਂ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। 'The server', subordinate clause ਦਾ subject ਹੈ, main clause ਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'Simran and Kabir submitted separate applications.'
explanation: Two names joined by 'and' form the compound subject. Selecting either name alone leaves out one person performing the action.
explanation_pa: 'and' ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੇ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਨਾਂ ਮਿਲ ਕੇ compound subject ਬਣਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਇੱਕ ਨਾਂ ਚੁਣਨ ਨਾਲ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'Why did the district officer postpone the hearing?'
explanation: The subject is 'the district officer', placed between the auxiliary 'did' and the main verb. The auxiliary remains part of the predicate.
explanation_pa: subject 'the district officer' ਹੈ, ਜੋ auxiliary 'did' ਅਤੇ main verb ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ। auxiliary ਵੀ predicate ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete predicate in: 'Our neighbours installed a rainwater tank yesterday.'
explanation: The complete predicate includes the verb and everything stated about the subject. 'A rainwater tank yesterday' omits the verb 'installed'.
explanation_pa: complete predicate ਵਿੱਚ verb ਅਤੇ subject ਬਾਰੇ ਕਹੀ ਗਈ ਸਾਰੀ ਗੱਲ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। 'A rainwater tank yesterday' ਵਿੱਚ verb 'installed' ਰਹਿ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'The village librarian issued fresh membership cards.'
explanation: The complete subject names who performs the action and includes its modifiers: 'The village librarian'. The membership cards receive the action and form the object.
explanation_pa: complete subject ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਕੰਮ ਕੌਣ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਸ ਦੇ modifiers ਵੀ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ: 'The village librarian'। membership cards ਉੱਤੇ ਕੰਮ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਉਹ object ਹਨ।

subject: English
question: In the existential sentence 'There remain several unresolved objections', which expression is the grammatical dummy subject, as distinct from the postverbal noun phrase?
explanation: Existential 'there' occupies the grammatical subject position as a dummy subject. 'Several unresolved objections' is the postverbal noun phrase, often called the notional subject.
explanation_pa: ਹੋਂਦ ਦਰਸਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਾ 'there', dummy subject ਵਜੋਂ grammatical subject ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Several unresolved objections', verb ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲਾ noun phrase ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਅਕਸਰ notional subject ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'The quality of the answers, rather than their length, determines the marks.'
explanation: The subject is headed by 'quality', with 'of the answers' modifying it. The parenthetical contrast 'rather than their length' does not introduce another subject.
explanation_pa: subject ਦਾ head noun 'quality' ਹੈ ਅਤੇ 'of the answers' ਇਸ ਦਾ modifier ਹੈ। ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਲਈ ਆਇਆ 'rather than their length' ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰ subject ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'Which applicant secured the highest score?'
explanation: The entire interrogative noun phrase 'Which applicant' is the subject. 'Applicant' alone omits its determiner.
explanation_pa: ਪੂਰਾ interrogative noun phrase 'Which applicant' subject ਹੈ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ 'Applicant' ਚੁਣਨ ਨਾਲ ਇਸ ਦਾ determiner ਰਹਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Select the correct division into complete subject and complete predicate: 'The clerk with the blue folder is waiting outside.'
options: The clerk / with the blue folder is waiting outside
The clerk with the blue / folder is waiting outside
The clerk with the blue folder is / waiting outside
The clerk with the blue folder / is waiting outside
explanation: The phrase 'with the blue folder' modifies 'clerk' and belongs to the complete subject. The predicate begins with the auxiliary 'is'.
explanation_pa: phrase 'with the blue folder', 'clerk' ਦਾ modifier ਹੈ ਅਤੇ complete subject ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਹੈ। predicate ਦੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤ auxiliary 'is' ਨਾਲ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'What the witness remembered changed the course of the inquiry.'
explanation: The entire clause 'What the witness remembered' is the subject of 'changed'. 'The witness' is only the subject inside that clause.
explanation_pa: ਪੂਰਾ clause 'What the witness remembered', 'changed' ਦਾ subject ਹੈ। 'The witness' ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਉਸ clause ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰਲਾ subject ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete predicate in: 'The new timetable has reduced waiting time considerably.'
explanation: The complete predicate includes both the auxiliary 'has' and the main verb with its dependants. Starting at 'reduced' incorrectly excludes part of the verb phrase.
explanation_pa: complete predicate ਵਿੱਚ auxiliary 'has', main verb ਅਤੇ main verb ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਸਾਰੇ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ। 'reduced' ਤੋਂ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰਨ ਨਾਲ verb phrase ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਗ਼ਲਤ ਤਰੀਕੇ ਨਾਲ ਬਾਹਰ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'Neither the cashier nor the branch manager noticed the discrepancy.'
options: Neither the cashier nor the branch manager
explanation: The paired conjunctions 'neither ... nor' connect both noun phrases into the compound subject. Selecting only the nearer noun phrase gives an incomplete subject.
explanation_pa: ਜੋੜੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ conjunctions 'neither ... nor' ਦੋਵੇਂ noun phrases ਨੂੰ ਜੋੜ ਕੇ compound subject ਬਣਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਨੇੜੇ ਵਾਲਾ noun phrase ਚੁਣਨ ਨਾਲ subject ਅਧੂਰਾ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'Only after the final bell did the invigilator collect the answer sheets.'
explanation: An initial restrictive expression beginning with 'only' triggers auxiliary-subject inversion. 'The final bell' is part of the time expression, while 'the invigilator' performs the action.
explanation_pa: ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਵਿੱਚ 'only' ਨਾਲ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਸੀਮਾ ਲਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਾ expression, auxiliary-subject inversion ਕਰਵਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। 'The final bell' ਸਮਾਂ ਦੱਸਣ ਵਾਲੇ expression ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਹੈ, ਜਦਕਿ ਕੰਮ 'the invigilator' ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'Near the main gate stood two security guards.'
explanation: The sentence places the location first and the subject after 'stood'. 'The main gate' belongs to the introductory prepositional phrase.
explanation_pa: ਇਸ ਵਾਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਥਾਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਦੱਸੀ ਗਈ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ subject, 'stood' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। 'The main gate' ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਏ prepositional phrase ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'The principal, along with two senior teachers, has reviewed the arrangements.'
options: The principal and two senior teachers
explanation: The supplementary phrase 'along with two senior teachers' does not form a compound subject with 'The principal'. Replacing 'along with' by 'and' would change the sentence's grammatical structure.
explanation_pa: ਵਾਧੂ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ phrase 'along with two senior teachers', 'The principal' ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲ ਕੇ compound subject ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ। 'along with' ਦੀ ਥਾਂ 'and' ਲਾਉਣ ਨਾਲ ਵਾਕ ਦੀ grammatical structure ਬਦਲ ਜਾਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: In 'Harpreet, submit the original certificate today', what is the understood grammatical subject of the imperative clause?
explanation: The imperative has the understood subject 'you'. 'Harpreet', separated by a comma, is a vocative identifying the person addressed.
explanation_pa: ਇਸ imperative ਵਿੱਚ subject 'you' ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਗਿਆ, ਪਰ ਸਮਝਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। comma ਨਾਲ ਵੱਖ ਕੀਤਾ 'Harpreet' ਇੱਕ vocative ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਕਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਸੰਬੋਧਨ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'Attached to the notice were copies of the amended guidelines.'
explanation: The fronted complement causes inversion, placing the complete subject after 'were'. 'The amended guidelines' is only the complement of 'of' within that subject.
explanation_pa: complement ਨੂੰ ਅੱਗੇ ਲਿਆਉਣ ਕਾਰਨ inversion ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ complete subject, 'were' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। 'The amended guidelines' ਉਸ subject ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਸਿਰਫ਼ 'of' ਦਾ complement ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'The proposal that the committee approved yesterday needs further funding.'
options: The proposal that the committee approved yesterday
explanation: The relative clause modifies 'proposal' and forms part of the complete subject. 'The committee' is the subject of the embedded relative clause only.
explanation_pa: relative clause, 'proposal' ਦਾ modifier ਹੈ ਅਤੇ complete subject ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਬਣਦਾ ਹੈ। 'The committee' ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਅੰਦਰ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ relative clause ਦਾ subject ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Identify the complete subject in: 'Checking every entry before submission prevents avoidable errors.'
explanation: The whole gerund phrase functions as the subject, including the time modifier 'before submission'. 'Every entry' is the object within that phrase.
explanation_pa: ਪੂਰਾ gerund phrase subject ਵਜੋਂ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਮਾਂ ਦੱਸਣ ਵਾਲਾ modifier 'before submission' ਵੀ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੈ। 'Every entry' ਉਸ phrase ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ object ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: What is the understood subject of the imperative sentence 'Keep your admit card ready'?
explanation: An imperative normally has the understood subject 'you'. 'Your admit card' is the object of 'keep', not the subject.
explanation_pa: imperative ਵਿੱਚ ਆਮ ਤੌਰ ਉੱਤੇ subject 'you' ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਂਦਾ, ਪਰ ਸਮਝਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। 'Your admit card', 'keep' ਦਾ object ਹੈ, subject ਨਹੀਂ।
